scene: Your flute melody opens three sparkling transit portals along the garden wall.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the courtyard terrace. On the left, a sleek pink bullet train waits at a neon platform. Centre, the player in red bomber jacket and roller skates lowers the glowing crystal flute. On the right, a solar-sail junk boat bobs at a canal dock. Up high, a spherical glass cloud pod hangs from cables.
